narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Mana Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, is this the potion I requested?<The elven woman respectfully takes the vial from you.>Your arrival is timely, and generosity deeply appreciated. I accept this, and offer you a small token of my gratitude.Thank you, may we meet again.
narrative.requestItemsText: Good day, friend. I appreciate the company but my attention is elsewhere. If we do not have business, please be on your way.
